title: Hunts FH-020T: Wire the staff scan screen and held-claim review screen to the door route and review actions

source.ref: Split from FH-020S (2026-11-10): the nonce table, door route, review, override and appeal shipped dark; the screens that call them are separate.

detail:
Mount components/hunts/staff-proof-screens.tsx at app/(main)/hunts/staff, post a scanned or typed code to /api/hunts/staff/verify, list held claims (hunt_claims.state = needs_review) for the reviewer's venue, and call lib/hunts/staff-review.ts reviewClaim through a server action behind decide('review_claim'). Show the player's appeal button on a rejected claim. Done when: the staff page renders signed in as venue staff with HUNTS_CLAIMS_ENABLED on and 404s otherwise. Requires: FH-020S. Owner role: Game systems.

Packet 1 door slice: the existing POST accepts a scanned or typed signed staff token and resolves its mission from a unique binding for the signed venue, placement and active run's current Hunt version. Explicit scope and mission hints must match. The lookup rejects missing, stale and ambiguous bindings before the nonce is spent. Wrong-origin requests are refused. Existing staff checks still gate verification. Nonce spend and credit remain separate database calls, so a version change after the lookup can consume a nonce before the claim is refused. Player-side challenge issuance, the staff page, authoritative venue attribution for held claims, review and appeal controls, and signed-in browser acceptance remain open.
